title: Chapter 383
text:
Two days later …

Chi!

The cooling storage box was opened, and liquid nitrogen cold air flowed out.

Haier's appendages operated the metal pliers and took out ten test tubes filled with silver potions. This was a gene potion made from the spinal fluid of the Void Dragon race. The Void Dragon had a strong vitality, and their corpses and spinal cords were still active even after death. They would only disappear completely after a few hundred years. By extracting the active factors, it could be made into a great tonic that could strengthen one's body. Most creatures could consume it, including humans.

"Ten sets of refined Void Dragon Marrow, these cute little things are yours." Haier's sharp teeth moved, and the translator translated into bug language.

The substantial reward that Floating Dragon gave Han Xiao was fifty kilograms of Void Dragon Bone and ten sets of Dragon Marrow. It was originally a hundred kilograms of Void Dragon Bone, but he had specially requested for half of the Void Dragon Bone to be replaced with Dragon Marrow. The effect of the Void Dragon Marrow was to permanently increase one's attributes without any side effects. It was extremely precious to the players.

Picking up a tube of Dragon Marrow, Han Xiao observed it carefully. The density was not as dense as mercury, and it was translucent and light silver. The potion was very pure and had a little bit of starlight. The item notification was triggered as soon as he touched it. After confirming that there was no mistake, Han Xiao loaded it into the injection gun and injected a tube of Dragon Marrow into his blood vessels.

You have used [Refined Void Dragon Marrow (High Concentration 42.2%)]. + 3 STR, + 4 END, + 2 CHA.

Han Xiao did not stop there and injected another two tubes of potion. The random increase of the attributes of the high-concentration potion was higher, and after three consecutive injections, he gained + 8 STR, + 2 END, and + 2 CHA.

Potions that permanently increased attributes usually had a limit, and the Void Dragon Marrow could only increase attributes three times before it lost its effect.

However, although it would not increase attributes after three times, there was a hidden effect. If he continued to use it, and the dosage reached a certain level, he would gain a talent called [Void Genes]. On the surface, it only increased his speed and dodging rate, but the real benefit was that it would affect his choice during his Race Evolution.

In his previous life, this was the result of a coincidence. One had to know that the Void Dragon Marrow was very rare, and it would not have any effect after three uses. Most people would not waste it. Han Xiao could not help but thank that rich tycoon. Otherwise, no one would know this secret.

"Based on the accumulation of medicinal properties, you'll need about twenty tubes of low concentration. For high concentration … ten tubes should be enough."

Han Xiaoxin calculated and injected more and more dragon marrow into his body. As more and more silver medicine mixed into his blood, he felt waves of palpitations. Some parts of his body started to change, and the silver light in his eyes grew deeper and deeper.

Haier said in surprise, "Hiss, hiss, hiss … Oh, sorry, the translator just dropped. You're injecting too often. Aren't you afraid of genetic mutations? You should know when to stop. "

Han Xiao shook his head, indicating that he was fine. What he wanted was a genetic mutation.

After injecting the seventh syringe, Han Xiao's body stiffened. A complicated feeling of coldness and heat exploded in his body. His feet were unsteady, and he staggered. His back hit the shelf, and he gasped for breath. His brows were furrowed so tightly that they could almost kill a fly.

He gritted his teeth. All the nerve endings in his body were transmitting the excruciating pain to his brain. Every blood vessel was throbbing and bulging!

You have received talent [Void Genes]!

After a while, the pain lessened. It felt like a century had passed. Han Xiao heaved a sigh of relief and wiped away the cold sweat on his forehead. Suddenly, he touched a bulge. It felt a little hard, like a scale.

He took out a mirror and looked at it. His pupils became silver, and there did not seem to be any abnormalities between his eyebrows. However, he clearly touched a diamond-shaped skin that had hardened.

When he activated his energy, the cells in his body became active. This diamond-shaped skin turned from flesh to bright silver. It was very obvious.

"Woah! Guanjiangkou Erlang Xian?! "

Han Xiao was amazed. Not only did this silver mark not ruin his handsomeness, it even made him look more fashionable. If it shone a little brighter, he would be able to imitate Solar Fist.

This was a new organ produced by genetic mutation, and it was also a change brought by [Void Genes]. It could be used to increase one's perception of space.

Han Xiao had obtained this Molding Talent a long time ago, and it had accompanied him through all kinds of dangers. The last time, he had injected another type of genetic agent. This time, the Void Dragon Marrow had allowed this BSS Molding Talent to evolve again. The conversion ratio between END and HP had increased from 5 to 30, doubling it and giving him an additional 25% Resistance.

This was a complete surprise. Players could not have Molding Talents. This was the first time Han Xiao knew that Molding Talents could be upgraded. His maximum HP had increased by more than 4,000, which was equivalent to one-third of his original HP.

"I've left a trail of dust behind me on the path of meat and will never return." Han Xiao's eyes lit up as he speculated, "More precious genetic agents can increase the level of [Enhanced Life Force]. If you want to level up, you have to inject more genetic agents into your body … However, genetic agents can't be used carelessly. Otherwise, it will cause a rejection reaction that will cause gene mutation or even gene collapse. The best choice must be something like this that has no side effects."

This discovery gave Han Xiao a new idea, and his need for Molding Talents became even more urgent. Unfortunately, it was not something that could be obtained just because he wanted it. He kept the remaining three Dragon Marrow. This kind of precious item could be used as a "Favorability Bait". He set a ridiculously high price for it and let the players work for him wholeheartedly.

After putting away the materials, his communicator rang and Jenny requested a call.

"Black Star, Her Excellency Ames is looking for you."

A new virtual holographic screen popped up on the communicator, and Ames's delicate face appeared. Her body floated directly in the vacuum of the universe, surrounded by a force field for protection. Behind her, countless rays of light surged and seemed to fill up every inch of space. It was no less than the scene of a galactic fleet firing lasers at the same time. It seemed like she was fighting a strong enemy. However, all the rays of light were bounced off by an invisible force field barrier and bombarded onto a desolate planet below. It was obvious that the battle had lasted for a while. One-tenth of the desolate planet had collapsed, like an apple that had been bitten. The broken meteorites and dust swirled around the planet, mixing with the escaping gas and forming a 'cloud ring'. It was estimated that the planet would have died billions of years earlier if the battle had continued for a while … No, this should be called a young man dying prematurely, and a beautiful woman had a short life.

With just a glance, Han Xiao could confirm that Ames was fighting with another Beyond Grade A of the Shattered Star Ring. In less than three days, the galactic news would definitely broadcast the following content:

[Shattered Star Ring News: Two Supers are willfully fighting each other. An innocent planet has met with misfortune!] [Beyond Grade A Supers are maliciously destroying the environment. The Planetary Protection Association strongly condemns!] [Today's Planet Code Cancellation List] …

Speaking of which, it seems like because of my news, Ames was in a bad mood and found someone to fight. What a pity for a young planet …

Han Xiao's eyes twitched. He coughed and asked, "Your Excellency Dragon Emperor, what mission do you have for me?"

Ames opened her mouth to speak, but there was only silence. She woke up and controlled her force field to grab a cloud of gas from the planet, creating a large force field to cover herself before speaking.

"I heard Jenny's report. Your team has excellent combat ability, so it's a waste to stay on Floating Dragon Island. Anyway, you were originally a mercenary, so I approve of your outside activities. I have a mission for you … You've seen my teacher before, so help me find out more about him," Ames said.

He had made a request to Jenny a few days ago, using the excuse that Floating Dragon Island had enough manpower and that it would be a waste for him to stay on Floating Dragon Island. Floating Dragon Island only had three management positions — guards, butlers, and logistics. It just so happened that they lacked field troops, and the undying Black Star Mercenary was the best choice. At least they would not have to worry about losses. Jenny felt that it made sense and reported it to Ames. Ames had never doubted the people she used, so she was not worried that Han Xiao would leave her after leaving Floating Dragon Island.

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

Not being trapped on Floating Dragon Island was great news, and it would not delay the growth of his mercenary group. Although Floating Dragon Island was good, he had joined because he had no other choice. As long as he could move freely, this problem would be greatly reduced.

After finalizing the result, Han Xiaoxin hung up the communication. The upper echelons of the three armies would arrive soon, and he would be able to go back with them to hand in the mission.

"Everything went smoothly today." Han Xiao had a happy expression on his face. Could it be that his luck had finally changed?

Aroshia was waiting at the door. Han Xiao waved his hand and brought her out of the warehouse. He was worried about letting Aroshia run around alone, so he always brought her with him when he was free.

They entered an empty street. After walking for a while, Han Xiao's relaxed expression suddenly disappeared, and he frowned. He felt that the atmosphere was weird, so he shielded Aroshia behind him and looked around vigilantly.

"Your senses are not bad."

A person's voice sounded out of nowhere. It had a cold tone of judgment, and it was filled with confidence in his own strength. Han Xiao felt that the voice was familiar.

At the same time, hard walls suddenly extended from the ground around them, covering the sky and trapping the two of them inside like a cage.

The warriors of the Dark-star Task Force appeared and surrounded the two of them.

Ashes stood at the front and looked at Han Xiao with an expressionless face, as if everything was under his control.

"Black Star Mercenary Captain, we need your cooperation. Come with us, and you will suffer less if you don't resist."
